# FC-2B independent reading

Only the supplied packet was used. Unrotated page size 3263 x 4508. Upper range 0..6000 psf; lower range -100..100 thousandths. Displacement labels 0,50,100,150,200,250; the right legend frame is excluded. The lower ordinate label is printed gamma_sigma rather than delta_sigma, a labeling typo; values are dilation displacement.

Legend: asterisk=4400; x=3660; square=2995; triangle-up=2200; hollow circle=1468; solid filled circle=734. The circle symbol name is used for both circle styles with fill noted. The square legend clearly prints 2935, as confirmed in legend-detail.png. The supplied series ID n2995 and stress 2995 are retained as explicitly instructed; the page/table discrepancy is flagged without outside reconciliation.

A first upper calibration tracked the 734-psf curve into the 1000-psf grid; higher coverage and narrower tracking thresholds resolved that. The predicted 5000 upper line was checked at v~1377 in its short visible sections beside the annotation. All RMS residuals are below 0.5% of span. The lower zero grid is slightly off the midpoint of the +100/-100 frame: the maximum affine ordinate residual is about 1.30 thousandths (0.65% of span), despite revised thresholds. This reflects the visible nonuniform grid spacing and is flagged; RMS is about 0.83 thousandths. The native reading bounds include the RMS calibration residual as required by the supplied apply tool.

The upper n3660 curve starts near (820,2491), bends left to u~814 around v=2450, and then rises to the next x marker. That initial branch is read explicitly in drawing order; prefix trace points and a bend feature preserve the short reversal. No x sorting was applied. The square and triangle fits are smoothly rounded; their marker centers do not necessarily coincide with the trace. Upper n734 filled symbols are merged into the thick stroke and the 1000 grid at late displacement; centers retain 6-px bounds. The fit crosses that grid and is separately sampled only where discernible. Features at broad maxima have wide bounds. Some final markers are on or slightly beyond x=250.

The lower panel has six vertically stacked symbol rows, with substantial shared ink. The four lower rows (asterisk/x/square/triangle) are read at the 24 visible stacks from roughly x=20 to 250, with 8-px center bounds and identity uncertainty notes. Early hollow/filled circles overlap both one another and the zero grid, and receive 7-px bounds. There are 20 assigned hollow circles and 16 assigned filled circles; late filled circles occur at larger irregular displacement intervals. Near x=50,100,150,200,250 the stacks also share grid ink. Distinguishing the early filled/hollow circles and the square/triangle pair is weak; those rows should be reviewed from the image. The hollow shape at (734,3265) is the printed ordinate zero label outside the frame and is not counted as a marker. A possible lower marker for any series near x=10, apart from the visible hollow circle near (817,3275), is not separately recoverable from zero-line ink and is omitted. No connecting lower curves are drawn.
